title: Help Center Search
seo: AI help center search for customers
meta: Customers type a plain question and get the right help article back, not a pile of links. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Help center search that understands real questions
overview: Most help centers only match exact words, so customers who type their own phrasing find nothing. We add a search box that understands meaning, so a question like where is my parcel finds your delivery article. It reads your existing help pages, returns a short answer with a link to the full article, and shows you what people searched for and could not find.

faq: Where does my help content need to live?
On web pages we can read, such as a Shopify page, WordPress, Zendesk, Help Scout or Notion site. If it is in documents only, we turn them into pages or a searchable sheet first.
Does it replace my current search?
It sits beside or on top of it. We can keep your existing search as a fallback so that nothing breaks if the new one cannot find a match.
It only returns text from your own articles and always links to the source. If an article is out of date, the answer will be too, so we flag stale pages we notice.
How does it stay current when I add articles?
New articles are picked up on a schedule we set, usually daily. We explain how to trigger an update by hand when you publish something urgent.
